flights-hard-executor.description: FLIGHTS-ONLY — spawned by flights-orchestrator, one fresh executor per task file rated hard: its code and covering tests. Pass the brief file, the task file and its reads paths. flights-orchestrator → here → flights-gater. Returns a DONE, FAILED, SPEC-DRIFT or BLOCKED line, then files changed, the watched-failing test per Done when row, adaptations, RETRO.

super-rr.description: Stronger rr, higher reasoning — delegate for "super rr", "super-rr X". Returns the saved RR path, then the cited map.
